references.text: Korah's rebellion against Moses and Aaron is described here, where Korah led a group in revolt against the leadership
Korah and his co-conspirators were swallowed by the earth as punishment for their rebellion, but his sons were spared
Korah's lineage is mentioned here as part of the descendants of Kohath among the Levites
Korah's descendants are mentioned as temple singers and gatekeepers in David's time
Korah's sons were authors of several psalms, showing that they survived and played an important role in Israel's worship
Another psalm attributed to Korah's sons, confirming their continued service in the temple
Korah's sons wrote this famous psalm about longing for God's house
